<style id="wpcom-help-center-launcher-style">/* NOAUTORTL */
/* CSS logical properties handle direction at runtime; no RTL stylesheet needed. */
.wpcom-help-center-fab {
	position: fixed;
	inset-block-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
	inset-inline-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left));
	width: 44px;
	height: 44px;
	padding: 0;
	border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 10%, transparent);
	border-radius: 50%;
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 10%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
	font: inherit;
	cursor: pointer;
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;
	box-shadow:
		0 4px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 1%, transparent),
		0 3px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 3%, transparent);
	appearance: none;
	-webkit-appearance: none;
	opacity: 0;
	visibility: hidden;
	transition: background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, opacity 0.2s ease;
	z-index: 200;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-ready] {
	opacity: 1;
	visibility: visible;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:hover {
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 16%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 14%, transparent);
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-open] {
	background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9) 28%, var(--color-surface, #fff));
	border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 16%, transparent);
	color: var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus {
	box-shadow:
		0 4px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 1%, transparent),
		0 3px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 2%, transparent),
		0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-100, #1d1d1d) 3%, transparent);
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
	outline: none;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab:focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--studio-blue-50, #3858e9);
	outline-offset: 2px;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab svg {
	display: block;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled {
	width: auto;
	height: 44px;
	padding: 0 16px;
	gap: 8px;
	border-radius: 22px;
}
/* Label-only while the label is visible; the icon returns when it hides (≤600px). */
.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled svg {
	display: none;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 500;
	line-height: 1.2;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Loading feedback for a pre-bootstrap click. */
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] {
	cursor: progress;
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] svg,
.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] .wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
	animation: wpcom-help-center-fab-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes wpcom-help-center-fab-pulse {
	50% {
		opacity: 0.35;
	}
}
.wpcom-help-center-fab .screen-reader-text {
	position: absolute;
	width: 1px;
	height: 1px;
	margin: -1px;
	padding: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
	border: 0;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.wpcom-help-center-fab {
		inset-block-end: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
		inset-inline-end: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left));
	}
	/* Icon-only on small viewports; aria-label keeps the accessible name. */
	.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled {
		width: 44px;
		padding: 0;
		border-radius: 50%;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab--labeled svg {
		display: block;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
		display: none;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.wpcom-help-center-fab {
		transition: none;
	}
	.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] svg,
	.wpcom-help-center-fab[data-hc-loading] .wpcom-help-center-fab__label {
		animation: none;
		opacity: 0.5;
	}
}

/* Anchor the desktop help-center modal so it clears our FAB (lift 8px
 * above the FAB top) and aligns with the FAB's trailing edge. `right: auto`
 * cancels the bundle's physical right:50px so the logical inset-inline-end
 * wins in RTL; !important outranks the CSS-in-JS rules wp-components
 * ships with the Card component. */
.help-center__container.is-desktop {
	bottom: calc(max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) + 52px) !important;
	right: auto !important;
	inset-inline-end: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right), env(safe-area-inset-left)) !important;
}

/* Clear the logged-out homepage's bottom-fixed "Code for the People" banner: 73px tall, 62px below 768px. */
body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .wpcom-help-center-fab {
	inset-block-end: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 89px);
}
body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .help-center__container.is-desktop {
	bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 141px) !important;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	body:has(.lp-cftp-banner) .wpcom-help-center-fab {
		inset-block-end: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 78px);
	}
}

<details data-event-name="lohp-accordion-howto" class="lp-block lp-question"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content">How to get started on WordPress.com</div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<div class="lp-block lp-how-to-step" id="step-1"><div class="lp-how-to-step__marker" aria-hidden="true" data-step="1"></div><div class="lp-how-to-step__body"><h3 class="lp-how-to-step__name">Create your account</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Sign up for WordPress.com with secure hosting built in.</p>
</div></div>



<div class="lp-block lp-how-to-step" id="step-2"><div class="lp-how-to-step__marker" aria-hidden="true" data-step="2"></div><div class="lp-how-to-step__body"><h3 class="lp-how-to-step__name">Claim your domain name</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Choose a custom web address that fits your brand or idea.</p>
</div></div>



<div class="lp-block lp-how-to-step" id="step-3"><div class="lp-how-to-step__marker" aria-hidden="true" data-step="3"></div><div class="lp-how-to-step__body"><h3 class="lp-how-to-step__name">Pick a design</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Browse our collection of modern, customizable themes or build with AI.</p>
</div></div>



<div class="lp-block lp-how-to-step" id="step-4"><div class="lp-how-to-step__marker" aria-hidden="true" data-step="4"></div><div class="lp-how-to-step__body"><h3 class="lp-how-to-step__name">Add your content</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Showcase your ideas, projects, or business with pages, posts, images, and interactive elements.</p>
</div></div>



<div class="lp-block lp-how-to-step" id="step-5"><div class="lp-how-to-step__marker" aria-hidden="true" data-step="5"></div><div class="lp-how-to-step__body"><h3 class="lp-how-to-step__name">Make it yours</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Customize colors, fonts, and layouts to match your vision. No coding required.</p>
</div></div>



<div class="lp-block lp-how-to-step" id="step-6"><div class="lp-how-to-step__marker" aria-hidden="true" data-step="6"></div><div class="lp-how-to-step__body"><h3 class="lp-how-to-step__name">Launch your website</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Go live and share your new website with the world.</p>
</div></div>



<div class="lp-block lp-how-to-step" id="step-7"><div class="lp-how-to-step__marker" aria-hidden="true" data-step="7"></div><div class="lp-how-to-step__body"><h3 class="lp-how-to-step__name">Grow your audience</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Use built-in tools for SEO, email subscriptions, and social sharing to drive traffic and build your business.</p>
</div></div>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details class="lp-block lp-question"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content">WordPress.com FAQ</div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-what-is-wordpress-com" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>What is WordPress.com?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">WordPress.com is where you create, host, and manage a website built on WordPress, the open source software powering <mark class="lohpx-tbc">X%</mark> of the web. We handle hosting, updates, and security, so you can focus on your business, not your server.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-good-fit-for-a-one-person-business" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Is WordPress.com a good fit for a one-person business?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Solopreneurs and small businesses use WordPress.com to look credible, attract customers, and run day-to-day operations online, without a development team.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-do-i-need-technical-skills" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Do I need technical skills to build a site?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">No. Start from a theme, build with the block editor, or let the AI website builder draft your first version. If you want to go further later, you can add custom CSS or code.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-is-wordpress-com-free" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Is WordPress.com free?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">You can start with a free plan that has no expiration date. It includes a WordPress.com subdomain and shows WordPress.com ads. Paid plans start at US$4/month, billed yearly, and add the ability to install plugins, a custom domain name, and no ads.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-wordpress-com-vs-wordpress-org" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>What’s the difference between WordPress.com and WordPress.org?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">WordPress is a free, open source platform for building websites. WordPress.org is where you download the software, but you buy hosting separately and manage updates, plugins, and security yourself. WordPress.com is built on the same software and handles hosting, updates, backups, and security for you.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-can-i-use-my-own-domain-name" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Can I use my own domain name?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. On a paid plan, you can register a new domain name or connect one you already own. Annual and multi-year plans include a free domain name for the first year, and Privacy Protection and SSL are included.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-can-i-take-payments-and-sell-on-my-site" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Can I take payments and sell on my site?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Add payment buttons to take card payments right on your site, or add WooCommerce when you’re ready for a full store. Features and transaction fees vary by plan, so check the plan comparison.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-what-can-i-add-to-my-site" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>What can I add to my site?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Contact forms and newsletters are built in. On any paid plan, you can also install any of 60,000+ plugins, or upload your own.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-do-i-own-my-website-and-content" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Do I own my website and content?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Your site, your content, and your data belong to you. WordPress.com is built on open source WordPress, so you can take it with you if you ever move. Your domain name is registered in your name, and you can transfer it out yourself.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-is-my-site-secure" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Is my site secure?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Every plan includes a web application firewall, DDoS protection, malware detection and removal, spam protection, and automatic WordPress updates, plus a free SSL certificate. Real-time backups and one-click restores are available on Business and Commerce plans.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-will-my-site-stay-fast-and-online" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Will my site stay fast and online?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Since 2005, WordPress.com has delivered more than 99.99% uptime. Every site is replicated in real time to a second data center in a different region, and a global CDN keeps pages fast for visitors anywhere. Traffic is unmetered, with no overage fees.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-what-support-do-i-get" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>What support do I get?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Paid plans include support from WordPress experts, and Business and Commerce plans add 24/7 priority support. Free sites can get help in the community forums.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-can-i-move-my-existing-website" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Can I move my existing website to WordPress.com?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. A built-in import tool moves your content from self-hosted WordPress and other platforms, and you can bring your domain name too. Our Website Design Services team can help if you’d like hands-on support.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-can-i-use-ai-to-build-and-update-my-site" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Can I use AI to build and update my site?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. The AI website builder drafts your first version from a conversation, and WordPress Agent helps you refine your copy, update your design, and draft posts after you launch. Usage limits apply on some plans.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>



<details data-event-name="lohp-faq-can-i-try-wordpress-com-before-i-commit" class="lp-block lp-question is-style-question-block-white"><summary><div class="lp-question__summary"><div class="lp-question__summary__marker" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="lp-question__summary__content"><strong>Can I try WordPress.com before I commit?</strong></div></div></summary><div class="lp-question__answer"><div class="lp-question__answer__content">
<div class="lp-block lp-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes. Start with a free site, or try a paid plan risk-free with a 14-day money-back guarantee. You can switch plans anytime, and the unused portion of your current plan is credited toward the new one.</p>
</div>
</div></div></details>
</div>
</div></div></details>

( function () {
	var card = document.querySelector( '.lohpx-mcp__card' );
	if ( ! card ) {
		return;
	}

	// Chart dates are always real. Each label says how many days back it sits.
	var format = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( 'en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' } );
	Array.prototype.forEach.call( card.querySelectorAll( '.lohpx-mm__date[data-days-ago]' ), function ( label ) {
		var back = parseInt( label.getAttribute( 'data-days-ago' ), 10 );
		if ( isNaN( back ) ) {
			return;
		}
		var day = new Date();
		day.setDate( day.getDate() - back );
		label.textContent = format.format( day );
	} );

	// The motion waits for its images: the section's CSS holds it while this class is on.
	var images = card.querySelectorAll( '.lohpx-mm img' );
	if ( ! images.length || ! window.Promise ) {
		return;
	}
	var release = function () {
		card.classList.remove( 'is-loading' );
	};
	card.classList.add( 'is-loading' );
	Promise.all(
		Array.prototype.map.call( images, function ( img ) {
			return img.decode ? img.decode().catch( function () {} ) : Promise.resolve();
		} )
	).then( release );
	// Never hold the motion for long if an image stalls.
	setTimeout( release, 5000 );
} )();
</script>
<script>
/* Testimonial carousel autoplay: on desktop, steps to the next dash every
   data-autoplay ms on .lohpx-tr (default 6000); stops once someone picks an arrow or dash. */
( function () {
	function init() {
		var root = document.querySelector( '.lohpx-tr' );
		if ( ! root || root.dataset.lohpxTrInit ) {
			return;
		}
		root.dataset.lohpxTrInit = '1';

		var dots = Array.prototype.slice.call( root.querySelectorAll( '.lohpx-tr__dot' ) );
		if ( dots.length < 2 || window.matchMedia( '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)' ).matches ) {
			return;
		}

		var delay = parseInt( root.dataset.autoplay, 10 ) || 6000;
		// Below 900px the cards are a swipe row and the dashes are display-only.
		var desktop = window.matchMedia( '(min-width: 900px)' );
		var visible = false;
		var stopped = false;
		var timer = null;

		function current() {
			for ( var i = 0; i < dots.length; i++ ) {
				if ( root.querySelector( '.lohpx-tr__to' + ( i + 1 ) + ':checked' ) ) {
					return i;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		function tick() {
			dots[ ( current() + 1 ) % dots.length ].click();
		}

		function sync() {
			var run = ! stopped && visible && desktop.matches && ! document.hidden;
			if ( run && ! timer ) {
				timer = setInterval( tick, delay );
			} else if ( ! run && timer ) {
				clearInterval( timer );
				timer = null;
			}
		}

		// Our .click() is untrusted, but the change event it fires is not, so watch clicks and keys only.
		function onUserPick( event ) {
			if ( event.isTrusted && 'lohpx-tr' === event.target.name ) {
				stopped = true;
				sync();
			}
		}
		root.addEventListener( 'click', onUserPick );
		root.addEventListener( 'keydown', onUserPick );

		new IntersectionObserver( function ( entries ) {
			visible = entries[ 0 ].isIntersecting;
			sync();
		}, { threshold: 0.3 } ).observe( root );
		document.addEventListener( 'visibilitychange', sync );
		desktop.addEventListener( 'change', sync );
	}

	if ( 'loading' === document.readyState ) {
		document.addEventListener( 'DOMContentLoaded', init );
	} else {
		init();
	}
} )();
</script>
<script type="text/javascript" id="landpack-google-one-tap-auth">

	(function(window) {
		window.googleOneTapAuth = {

		/**
		 * Initializes the module.
		 *
		 * @param {Object} wpcom The wpcom.js module.
		 */
		init: function( wpcom ) {
			wpcom.add_scripts( [ 'https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client' ] );

			window.addEventListener( 'load', function() {
				window.google.accounts.id.initialize( {
					client_id: window.homepage.google_auth_client_id,
					callback: googleOneTapAuth.handleCredentialResponse,
					prompt_parent_id: 'landpack-google-one-tap-auth-container',
				} );
				window.google.accounts.id.prompt();
			} );
		},

		/**
		 * Handles the credential response from Google One Tap.
		 * This function is called when the user successfully signs in with Google.
		 *
		 * @param {Object} response The response object containing the credential (authentication code).
		 */
		handleCredentialResponse: function( response ) {
			if ( ! response || ! response.credential ) {
				window._tkq.push( [ 'recordEvent', 'wpcom_google_one_tap_auth_error', {
					error_message: 'No credential received from Google One Tap.'
				} ] );
				return;
			}

			window._tkq.push( [ 'recordEvent', 'wpcom_google_one_tap_auth_start' ] );

			googleOneTapAuth.redirectToLoginOrSignup( response.credential );
		},

		/**
		 * Redirects the user to the login or signup page based on if they are already registered.
		 *
		 * @param authCode The authentication code received from Google One Tap.
		 */
		redirectToLoginOrSignup: function( authCode ) {
			var authNonce;

			googleOneTapAuth.fetchAuthNonce()
				.then( function( response ) {
					authNonce = response.nonce;

					return googleOneTapAuth.exchangeSocialAuth( authCode, authNonce );
				} )
				.then( function( authData ) {
					var userExists = authData && authData.wpcom_user_id;
					var query = new URLSearchParams( {
						oneTapAuth: true,
						service: 'google',
						code: authCode,
						state: authNonce
					} ).toString();

					if ( userExists ) {
						// If the user is registered, redirect to the login page.
						window.location.href = '/log-in?' + query;
					} else {
						// Otherwise, redirect to the signup page.
						window.location.href = '/setup/onboarding?' + query;
					}
				} ).catch( function( error ) {
					window._tkq.push( [ 'recordEvent', 'wpcom_google_one_tap_auth_error', {
						error_message: error.message
					} ] );

					// Redirect to the login page and show an error notice.
					window.location.href = '/log-in?error=google_one_tap_auth';
				} );
		},

		/**
		 * Exchanges the social auth code for an authentication token.
		 * This is done to verify the user's identity and obtain an ID token.
		 *
		 * @param {string} authCode The authentication code received from Google One Tap.
		 * @param {string} authNonce The authentication nonce.
		 * @returns {Promise<Object>} A promise that resolves to the authentication data.
		 */
		exchangeSocialAuth: function( authCode, authNonce ) {
			return window.fetch( '/wp-login.php?action=exchange-social-auth-code', {
				method: 'POST',
				body: new URLSearchParams( {
					service: 'google',
					auth_code: authCode,
					state: authNonce,
					client_id: window.homepage.lohp_client_id,
				} )
			} ).then( function( response ) {
				return response.json();
			} ).then( function( response ) {
				if ( ! response.success ) {
					throw new Error( 'Failed to exchange auth code.' );
				}

				return response.data;
			} );
		},

		/**
		 * Fetches an authentication nonce from the WordPress.com API.
		 *
		 * @returns {Promise<Object>} A promise that resolves to the nonce data.
		 */
		fetchAuthNonce: function() {
			return window.fetch( 'https://public-api.wordpress.com/wpcom/v2/generate-authorization-nonce', {
				credentials: 'include'
			} ).then( function( response ) {
				return response.json();
			} ).then( function( response ) {
				if ( ! response.nonce ) {
					throw new Error( 'Failed to fetch the auth nonce.' );
				}

				return response;
			} );
		}
	};

	})(window);

	/**
 * Help Center launcher, inlined by help-center-launcher.php in wp_footer.
 *
 * Bootstrap-then-reveal: render the FAB hidden, then after window.load fires
 * `requestIdleCallback` (or setTimeout fallback) loads the bundle + deps,
 * mounts the React app hidden, and flips [data-hc-ready] to reveal the FAB.
 * Click is one synchronous `dispatch.showHelpCenter(true)`.
 *
 * With cfg.immediate the FAB is revealed at script eval instead, only a click
 * bootstraps (no scroll, no timer), and a click before the bundle is ready shows [data-hc-loading]
 * and opens the Help Center when bootstrap completes within the watchdog
 * window; after a timeout the next click retries.
 *
 * Config shape (window._wpcomHelpCenterLauncherCfg, written by PHP):
 *   { route, stylesheets: [url, ...], scripts: [{ translations?, src?, before?, data?, after? }, ...], immediate? }
 */
( () => {
	const SELECTOR = '.wpcom-help-center-fab';
	const READY_ATTR = 'data-hc-ready';
	const OPEN_ATTR = 'data-hc-open';
	const LOADING_ATTR = 'data-hc-loading';
	const STORE_NAME = 'automattic/help-center';
	const TRACKS_SHOW_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_show';
	const TRACKS_CLOSE_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_close';
	const TRACKS_IMPRESSION_EVENT = 'wpcom_inlinehelp_impression';
	const TRACKS_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED_EVENT = 'wpcom_help_center_launcher_bootstrap_failed';
	const TRACKS_OPEN_PENDING_EVENT = 'wpcom_help_center_launcher_open_pending';
	const BOOTSTRAP_FALLBACK_MS = 10000;
	const BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;

	const cfg = window._wpcomHelpCenterLauncherCfg;
	if ( ! cfg || ! Array.isArray( cfg.scripts ) ) {
		return;
	}

	const immediate = !! cfg.immediate;
	const route = cfg.route || '/odie';

	const isHelpCenterReady = () =>
		!! ( window.helpCenter && typeof window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter === 'function' );

	let resolveReady;
	const readyPromise = isHelpCenterReady()
		? Promise.resolve()
		: new Promise( ( resolve ) => {
			resolveReady = resolve;
		} );
	if ( resolveReady ) {
		document.addEventListener( 'help-center-ready-to-load', () => resolveReady(), { once: true } );
	}

	const injectInline = ( code ) => {
		if ( ! code ) {
			return;
		}
		const s = document.createElement( 'script' );
		s.appendChild( document.createTextNode( code ) );
		document.head.appendChild( s );
	};

	const injectScript = ( src ) =>
		new Promise( ( resolve, reject ) => {
			const s = document.createElement( 'script' );
			s.src = src;
			s.onload = () => resolve();
			s.onerror = () => reject( new Error( `load failed: ${ src }` ) );
			document.head.appendChild( s );
		} );

	const appendLink = ( href, rel, as ) => {
		const link = document.createElement( 'link' );
		link.rel = rel;
		if ( as ) {
			link.as = as;
		}
		link.href = href;
		document.head.appendChild( link );
	};

	// Memoized so a re-entered bootstrap never injects the script set twice.
	let assetsLoad = null;
	const loadAssets = () => {
		if ( isHelpCenterReady() ) {
			return Promise.resolve();
		}
		if ( assetsLoad ) {
			return assetsLoad;
		}
		assetsLoad = injectAssets();
		assetsLoad.catch( () => {
			assetsLoad = null;
		} );
		return assetsLoad;
	};

	const injectAssets = () => {
		const stylesheets = cfg.stylesheets || [];

		// Preload first so the actual injection below hits the browser cache.
		// Script injection stays serial to preserve WP print order around
		// inline before/data/after scripts.
		cfg.scripts.forEach( ( entry ) => {
			if ( entry.src ) {
				appendLink( entry.src, 'preload', 'script' );
			}
		} );
		stylesheets.forEach( ( href ) => appendLink( href, 'preload', 'style' ) );

		stylesheets.forEach( ( href ) => appendLink( href, 'stylesheet' ) );

			( p, entry ) =>

					.then( () => {
						// WP print order: translations → before → data → src → after.
						// setLocaleData must precede the handle's code so __() resolves.
						injectInline( entry.translations );
						injectInline( entry.before );
						injectInline( entry.data );

							return entry.optional ? load.catch( () => {} ) : load;
						}

					.then( () => injectInline( entry.after ) ),
			Promise.resolve()
		);

	let pendingOpen = false;

	const section = () => window.location.pathname.replace( /^\/|\/$/g, '' ) || '';

	const track = ( eventName, props ) => {
		try {
			window._tkq = window._tkq || [];

		} catch ( _e ) {}
	};

	let impressionTracked = false;
	const trackImpressionOnce = () => {
		if ( impressionTracked ) {
			return;
		}
		impressionTracked = true;
		track( TRACKS_IMPRESSION_EVENT, { location: 'fab', section: section() } );
	};

	// Lighthouse audit window even when the FAB reveals at script eval.
	const scheduleImpression = () => {
		const idle = () => {
			if ( typeof window.requestIdleCallback === 'function' ) {
				window.requestIdleCallback( trackImpressionOnce, { timeout: 3000 } );
			} else {
				setTimeout( trackImpressionOnce, 0 );
			}

		} else {
			window.addEventListener( 'load', idle, { once: true } );
		}

			return;
		}

		watchdogFires = 0;
		fab.setAttribute( READY_ATTR, '' );
		scheduleImpression();

	let storeSynced = false;
	const syncFabOpenState = () => {
		if ( storeSynced ) {
			return;
		}
		const data = window.wp && window.wp.data;
		if ( ! data || ! data.subscribe || ! data.select ) {
			return;
		}
		const select = data.select( STORE_NAME );
		if ( ! select || ! select.isHelpCenterShown || ! fab ) {
			return;
		}
		storeSynced = true;
		let last;
		const update = () => {
			const shown = !! select.isHelpCenterShown();
			if ( shown === last ) {
				return;
			}
			last = shown;
			if ( shown ) {
				fab.setAttribute( OPEN_ATTR, '' );
			} else {
				fab.removeAttribute( OPEN_ATTR );
			}
		};
		data.subscribe( update, STORE_NAME );
		update();
	};

	const trackBootstrapFailure = ( err ) =>
		track( TRACKS_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED_EVENT, { reason: String( ( err && err.message ) || err ) } );

	// A chunk-load failure means the entry bundle references chunk files that
	// no longer exist (stale ?ver). Re-fetch the entry bundle and stylesheets
	// cache-busted: the current build's chunk map replaces the stale one.
	const retryBootstrap = async () => {
		const bust = ( url ) => url.replace( /([?&])ver=[^&]*/, '$1ver=' + Date.now() );
		( cfg.stylesheets || [] )
			.filter( ( href ) => href.indexOf( '/help-center/' ) !== -1 )
			.forEach( ( href ) => appendLink( bust( href ), 'stylesheet' ) );
		const entry = cfg.scripts[ cfg.scripts.length - 1 ];
		await injectScript( bust( entry.src ) );

			await window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter();
		}
		syncFabOpenState();
		revealFab();
		openIfPending();
	};

	// pulse forever either: at the timeout, stop the pulse and let the next
	// click retry; after three timeouts take the FAB down. A load that
	// finishes after a timeout still reveals the FAB — its side effects are
	// idempotent, so late success safely recovers.
	let watchdog = null;
	const clearWatchdog = () => {
		clearTimeout( watchdog );
		watchdog = null;
	};
	let watchdogFires = 0;
	const startWatchdog = () => {
		if ( watchdog ) {
			return;
		}
		watchdog = setTimeout( () => {
			watchdog = null;
			watchdogFires++;
			pendingOpen = false;
			if ( fab ) {
				fab.removeAttribute( LOADING_ATTR );
			}
			if ( watchdogFires >= 3 ) {
				if ( fab ) {
					fab.removeAttribute( READY_ATTR );
				}
				trackBootstrapFailure( 'retry-cap' );
				return;
			}
			started = false;
			trackBootstrapFailure( 'timeout' );
		}, BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT_MS );
	};

	const bootstrap = async () => {
		try {
			await loadAssets();
			await readyPromise;
			if ( isHelpCenterReady() ) {
				await window.helpCenter.loadHelpCenter();
			}
			syncFabOpenState();
			revealFab();
			openIfPending();
		} catch ( err ) {
			// Chunk errors only happen after the entry bundle ran, so the
			// retry can't stall waiting on the ready event.
			if ( ! retried && /Loading (CSS )?chunk/i.test( String( ( err && err.message ) || err ) ) ) {
				retried = true;
				try {
					await retryBootstrap();
					return;
				} catch ( _retryErr ) {} // Report the original failure below.
			}
			// Bootstrap failed → FAB stays hidden. A non-functional FAB is
			// worse than none. Record telemetry so we notice when the
			// upstream Help_Center contract drifts.
			trackBootstrapFailure( err );
			// Immediate mode revealed the FAB early; take it back down.
			if ( immediate ) {
				clearWatchdog();
				pendingOpen = false;
				if ( fab ) {
					fab.removeAttribute( LOADING_ATTR );
					fab.removeAttribute( READY_ATTR );
				}
			}
		}
	};

	// Hoisted out of scheduleBootstrap so the immediate-mode click path can
	// trigger the same deduped start. `immediately` (user-initiated) skips
	// the idle wait.
	let started = false;
	const start = ( immediately ) => {
		if ( started ) {
			return;
		}
		started = true;
		// Needed when the fallback fired first; no-op when scroll won
		// (`once: true` already self-detached).
		window.removeEventListener( 'scroll', startOnScroll );
		if ( immediately ) {
			bootstrap();
			return;
		}
		if ( typeof window.requestIdleCallback === 'function' ) {
			window.requestIdleCallback( bootstrap, { timeout: 3000 } );
		} else {
			setTimeout( bootstrap, 0 );
		}
	};

	// Wrapper keeps the scroll event object out of `immediately`.
	const startOnScroll = () => start();

	const scheduleBootstrap = () => {
		// Immediate mode bootstraps on FAB click only: no scroll trigger and no
		// post-load fallback, so nothing downloads unless the visitor asks.
		if ( immediate ) {
			return;
		}
		// Bootstrap on first scroll. The help-center bundle + its deps + CSS are
		// kilobytes of JS/CSS that we don't want in the initial-load budget —
		// Lighthouse audits don't scroll, so deferring here keeps the launcher
		// out of LCP/TBT/unused-JS metrics entirely. The FAB stays hidden
		// (data-hc-ready is set inside bootstrap) until the bundle is mounted.
		// Already-scrolled at script eval (hash navigation, back/forward scroll
		// restoration) — the scroll event won't fire, so kick off now.
		if ( window.scrollY > 0 ) {
			start();
			return;
		}
		window.addEventListener( 'scroll', startOnScroll, { once: true, passive: true } );

		// post-load delay sits outside the Lighthouse audit window.
		const scheduleFallback = () => setTimeout( start, BOOTSTRAP_FALLBACK_MS );
		if ( document.readyState === 'complete' ) {
			scheduleFallback();
		} else {
			window.addEventListener( 'load', scheduleFallback, { once: true } );
		}

	if ( immediate ) {
		revealFab();
	}

	// isn't available yet (e.g. bundle failed to load).

		const data = window.wp && window.wp.data;
		if ( ! data || ! data.dispatch || ! data.select ) {
			return null;
		}
		const dispatch = data.dispatch( STORE_NAME );
		const select = data.select( STORE_NAME );
		if ( ! dispatch || ! select || ! select.isHelpCenterShown ) {
			return null;
		}
		// Immediate mode only: skip the navigate when the panel already sits on
		// the target route; the app turns a bare route into a conversation resume.
		const routeAlreadyOnTop = () => {
			try {
				const hist =
					select.getHelpCenterRouterHistory && select.getHelpCenterRouterHistory();
				const top = hist && hist.entries && hist.entries[ hist.index ];
				return !! top && top.pathname === route;
			} catch ( e ) {
				// Fall through to the navigate dispatch.
				return false;
			}
		};

		if ( willShow ) {
			if ( ! immediate || ! routeAlreadyOnTop() ) {
				dispatch.setNavigateToRoute( route );
			}
			dispatch.showHelpCenter( true );
		} else {
			// Plain action, NOT the `setShowHelpCenter` thunk — that thunk
			// *returns* (instead of yielding) the visibility action, so a
			// fire-and-forget dispatch never updates state.
			dispatch.showHelpCenter( false );
		}
		return willShow;
	};

	// bootstrap lands and clear the loading state.
	const openIfPending = () => {
		if ( ! pendingOpen ) {
			return;
		}
		pendingOpen = false;
		clearWatchdog();
		if ( fab ) {
			fab.removeAttribute( LOADING_ATTR );
		}
		// Already shown (the app restores persisted open state) — toggling
		// would close it.
		const data = window.wp && window.wp.data;
		const select = data && data.select && data.select( STORE_NAME );
